## Dependencies that changed after your training data

Your training data (`claude-sonnet-5-5`, cutoff 2026-06-30) predates the versions this project pins. When a note below conflicts with what you remember, follow the note: it describes the installed version. Tags: [types] = diff of the published type declarations, [changelog] = release notes, [guide] = the package's upgrade guide, [summary] = summary of both.

**typescript** 6.0.3 → 7.0.2 (major)
- `CompilerOptions` options removed: `allowSyntheticDefaultImports`, `alwaysStrict`, `baseUrl`, `charset`, `downlevelIteration`, `importsNotUsedAsValues`, `keyofStringsOnly`, `noStrictGenericChecks` (+7 more). [types]
- `CompilerOptions` moved to `typescript/unstable/sync` [types]

**preact** 10.29.2 → 11.0.1 (major)
- Remove deprecated 'ForwardFn' type from compat (#4777, thanks @rschristian) [changelog]
- Drop IE11 support (#4549, thanks @JoviDeCroock) [changelog]
- `render()` no longer takes `replaceNode`; the `parent` argument no longer accepts `contains` [types]
  Before: `render(h(App, null), document.body, document.getElementById('root')!);` → After: `render(h(App, null), document.getElementById('root')!);` (type-checked)
- Breaking changes to outputs & pkg.json (#4652, thanks @rschristian) [changelog]
- Set oldProps's default value on declaration (#4959, thanks @ali-garajian) [changelog]
- Drop support for TS versions < 5.1 (#4788, thanks @rschristian) [changelog]
- Remove all export maps in nested pkg.json files (#4784, thanks @rschristian) [changelog]
- Also removed: `PropRef`, `MutableRef`. [types]
